Visual-novel creature sprite. A vast impossible mass that fills the frame and is clearly cropped by it: a slowly rotating knot of faceted low-polygon black geometry, folded planes that do not agree about which way is up, threaded through with long thin black tendrils that end in small human hands. Set into the mass, dozens of solid red eyes of different sizes, all open, all looking slightly different directions, plus one enormous red eye at the centre. No mouth. It should read as a shape that is wrong rather than a monster that is scary. Red used only for the eyes. Background is a completely flat uniform pure chroma green #00FF00 filling every pixel behind and around the mass, no shadow cast on it, hard clean edges.
